references.text: The Lord commanded that the land should be distributed by lot as an inheritance to the children of Israel.
The daughters of Zelophehad came forward with their case, and the Lord commanded that they should receive their father's inheritance.
The land was to be distributed by lot as an inheritance according to the clans.
Moses commanded the children of Israel that the land should be distributed by lot as an inheritance.
The daughters of Zelophehad received their share of the inheritance among their brothers in accordance with the Lord's command.
The children of Israel received their inheritance in the land of Canaan by lot.
